description: LibreJustice helps users research French and European case law and retrieve legal texts as they read on a specific date. It searches decisions from French administrative, judicial, constitutional, asylum and data-protection bodies as well as European courts, with filters for court, outcome, date and cited provisions. Users can open the full text of a decision, search French legislation and curated treaties or foreign codes, retrieve an article's version history, and review their own saved activity.
